'''Sachal Kand''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] when he witnessed a female [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], named [[Lakkna]], salvage war [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts from a crashed [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. He sent someone to prevent the warlord from creating a massive army to crush the [[Voss (species)|Voss]].
